notes.title: You can now Playtest Muri: Wildwoods! ˚ ｡⋆
notes.notes:
[h2]✧*̥˚ [b]IT’S TIME![/b] *̥˚✧[/h2][h3]You can now playtest Muri: Wildwoods here on Steam!!![/h3][previewyoutube="rzp5BgQDl04;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Some info[/h3][p]📅 The playtest is open to play from today the [b]20th of August until September 3rd[/b]. Make sure to get yourself, your family, your friends, your nephew and niece, [u]signed up before this Sunday the 24th[/u] when the signups close. If you’re already signed up before this date you will, as mentioned above, still be able to playtest the game in piece until the 3rd of September. 
[/p][p]⚠️ [b]This is a playtest of Muri: Wildwoods,[/b] [b]not a demo[/b]. That means the game does not have its final look, some things are currently a work in progress, the game might be a bit laggy or might even crash, and you may experience some bugs, but the game is ([i]hopefully[/i]) playable and we’d love for you to try it, give us some feedback, and let us know how it runs on your PC - so please answer the survey at the end of your test, find a link to it in the game. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/51acd65e295cf8c0f712e58b787b5df605f570d1.gif"][/img][/p][p]🍰 This slice of Muri: Wildwoods is from the one of the earlier areas you visit in the game, we call it the Ravines. [b]The full playtest should take around 30-60 minutes[/b], it depends on how much you want to complete and also how much time you spend petting the critters or watching the beautiful nature restore![/p][p][/p][p]🧩 This playtest should show you some of the core gameplay planned for Muri: Wildwoods; exploration, cleaning, cute critters, some smaller puzzle solving, platforming, and yes, more cleaning! [/p][p][/p][p]📋 Please feel free to share your experience and report feedback to us, there’s a form you can access in the game but you can also hop into our Discord and chat directly with our devs, [url="https://discord.gg/juPPejMsaF"][u]click here to join the server![/u][/url]
[/p][p]📷 It’s also a-okay, [i]even encouraged[/i], to [b]share screenshots, videos, or streams of the playtest[/b], so from us devs: Please have fun and be as creative as you’d like! We’re so excited to see you all play this small part of our game and hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoy making it. 
[/p][p]❓ [b]Need help?[/b] Write in our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3509370/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] or use the link above to hop into the Discord to reach us![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Have fun![/b][/p][p]🎮 [i]The Speldosa Team[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ [/p][h3][b]✧*̥ ˚ Join our Community *̥ ˚✧[/b] [/h3][p][url="https://discord.gg/juPPejMsaF" style="button"]Discord[/url]  [url="https://twitter.com/speldosagames" style="button"]Twitter[/url]  [url="https://www.instagram.com/speldosagames" style="button"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/speldosa.bsky.social" style="button"]Bluesky[/url]   [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@speldosagames" style="button"]TikTok[/url]   [url="https://www.threads.net/@speldosagames" style="button"]Threads[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Press and other business inquiries, reach us here: [url="https://contact@speldosa.com"]contact@speldosa.com[/url][/p][p]  [/p][h3]↶ Wishlist Muri: Wildwoods ↷[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_Wildwoods/"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][h3]↶ Try the prologue Project Shoreline ↷[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158500/Project_Shoreline/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: ˚✧ Muri: Wildwoods Playtest happening next week!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello, fellow Murii![/b][/p][p]We’re back with some [i]super[/i] exciting news. You know that playtest we’ve been promising... It’s finally happening!!![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Our Steam Playtest will go live on Wednesday, the 20th of August![/b] [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/5fe564a2c3c38b795dc5e6676cbaaebae67808fe.png"][/img] [/p][p][b]Sign up for the Playtest[/b] now on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_Wildwoods/"]our Steampage[/url], [b]Wishlist the game[/b] while you’re at it, so you don’t miss out on the full release, [b]Follow [/b]to know when our demo goes live, [b]grab a nice cup[/b] of your favorite hot beverage, and [b]wait for Wednesday[/b] to arrive ☕[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/b53f5aab401aa6790e774413a695f25d5362bff3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]📺 Feedback, Screenshots, Videos, and Streams are very encouraged![/b] [/h3][p]We’re so excited to see all your feedback, screenshots, and videos of playing this lil snippet of our game, so please don’t be afraid to share it anywhere!!! But please tag us in it, or share a link to your video or stream so we can look at it ❤️[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Some Development Updates[/b][/h3][p]We recently reached 13,000 wishlists(!!!), which is so incredibly cool. Thank you all so much! ♡ [/p][p]Now, let’s look at a few of the things we’ve been working on since we last spoke. [/p][p][/p][h3]The forest spirit![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/208df13b70d4905a16e146d9d32ebc3831db23d1.png"][/img][/p][p]We've been working on adding the big forest spirit to the game! They look a lot scarier in this screenshot than they actually are. [/p][p][/p][h3]More bounce![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/e157667c6f03cbe7ec66881141961817da205f1b.gif"][/img][/p][p]We want you to have a bunch of fun in Muri: Wildwoods, so we've been working on adding more interactivity to the objects you clean, like these bouncy bouyes![/p][p][/p][h3]Steampage Update![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334384/3fc5a09d1d2b7298ea9b9afdd1f11ecdc8a1cafb.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also given the Steampage a new look and an updated game description. Let us know what you think! These are just a few exciting things we've been working on these past few months, we're eager to show you even more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]That’s all for now Murii, see you next week!![/b][/p][p]🎮 The Speldosa Team[/p][p] [/p][p]‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾‾ [/p][h3][b]✧*̥ ˚ Join our Community *̥ ˚✧[/b] [/h3][p][url="https://discord.gg/juPPejMsaF" style="button"]Discord[/url]  [url="https://twitter.com/speldosagames" style="button"]Twitter[/url]  [url="https://www.instagram.com/speldosagames" style="button"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/speldosa.bsky.social" style="button"]Bluesky[/url]   [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@speldosagames" style="button"]TikTok[/url]   [url="https://www.threads.net/@speldosagames" style="button"]Threads[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Press and other business inquiries, reach us here: [url="https://contact@speldosa.com"]contact@speldosa.com[/url][/p][p]  [/p][h3]↶ Wishlist Muri: Wildwoods ↷[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_Wildwoods/"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][h3]↶ Try the prologue Project Shoreline ↷[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158500/Project_Shoreline/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

[h3]Hello, fellow Murii! [/h3]
Exciting news! This week we're part of [b]WINGS [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/womensdaysale]Women's Day Sale[/url][/b] on Steam, and tonight ([i]March 6th at 4 PM PT / 7 PM ET[/i]), we’ll be featured in the Women-Led Games Showcase on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QvjEUilTbrc&ab_channel=IGN]IGN[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@gamespot/streams]GameSpot[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Women-LedGames]WLG Youtube[/url]! 

We’re so happy to see games by women being celebrated—especially since half our team is made up of women and non-binary devs! If you haven’t already, check out some of the amazing games in the event—and don’t miss our trailer on the [i]big screen[/i]! 😁

[previewyoutube=QvjEUilTbrc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ✧ ˚ Announcing Muri: Wildwoods!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello fellow Murii! [/h3]
It's only been a few weeks since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158500/Project_Shoreline/]Project Shoreline[/url], the first adventure featuring the Muri, made its way to Steam but it's already time to tell you all about our next adventure...

[previewyoutube=mErrjOPhq7A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What is this?[/h2]
Muri: Wildwoods is a cozy cleaning adventure mixing satisfying cleaning with adventurous feelings all wrapped up in a cute visual style *̥ ˚✧

As seen in the trailer this new adventure features a bunch of critters, lush environments to clean and explore, and you'll also follow a narrative to find out more about the Muri and the world they live in, among some other things we'll tell you more about soon™

[h3]Wishlist Muri: Wildwoods![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284200/Muri_WildWoods

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]What is a Muri?[/b]
A Muri is a species that combines the qualities of mice and fishes into an adorable creature. You play as a Muri in both Project Shoreline and Muri: Wildwoods. 

[b]When is Muri: Wildwoods releasing? [/b]
We currently cannot tell as we're in the middle of developing it but we'll let you know as soon as a release date is more set in stone. 

[b]Will the game come to other platforms, such as console or mobile? [/b]
It's currently not planned but porting to console is something we're definitely interested in doing at some point in the future, most likely for Muri: Wildwoods if we get the chance to do it!
